added.title: Director, Platform Engineering
added.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa's Data Trust & Platform Engineering (DTPE) organization delivers the foundational platforms that power Visa's enterprise data, analytics, AI, and cloud ecosystem. DTPE is responsible for advancing secure, scalable, governed, and resilient data platform capabilities spanning hybrid-cloud infrastructure, compute, storage, streaming, orchestration, data governance, privacy, quality, and platform engineering services.

We are seeking a seasoned Director, Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important Platform Engineering organization based in Foster City. This leader will own execution, operational excellence, customer engagement, and technology strategy for a portfolio of mission-critical platform services that enable Visa's modern data and AI ecosystem.

As the senior DTPE engineering leader in Foster City, this role will act as the primary interface between platform engineering teams, data product organizations, architecture leaders, and executive stakeholders. The Director will drive platform modernization, hybrid-cloud adoption, engineering excellence, reliability, and operational maturity while building and leading high-performing engineering teams.

This position requires a strong blend of technical leadership, organizational influence, business acumen, customer obsession, and operational rigor.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the strategic roadmap for Platform Engineering aligned with Visa's enterprise data, AI, and hybrid-cloud transformation objectives.
Partner with senior leadership to shape long-term investment priorities, technology direction, and modernization initiatives.
Lead organizational planning, workforce strategy, succession planning, and engineering capability development.
Drive adoption of engineering best practices, automation, AI-assisted development, and platform self-service models.

Platform & Technology Leadership

Provide leadership for large-scale platform services supporting data, analytics, AI, and mission-critical enterprise workloads.
Drive modernization of platform architecture, cloud-native adoption, infrastructure automation, developer productivity, and platform reliability.
Establish engineering standards for scalability, resilience, observability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency.
Partner with architects and distinguished engineers to define technology roadmaps and future-state platform architectures.

Business & Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as the Foster City DTPE leader and primary point of engagement for US-based customers, partners, and engineering organizations.
Build strong partnerships across Data Platform, Product, Infrastructure, Security, Operations, and Architecture organizations.
Influence senior executives and stakeholders to align investments, priorities, and execution plans.
Represent DTPE in executive reviews, planning cycles, operational governance forums, and strategic transformation initiatives.

Engineering Delivery & Operational Excellence

Own delivery outcomes, service reliability, production readiness, and operational health for Platform Engineering services.
Drive measurable improvements in availability, performance, efficiency, developer experience, and platform adoption.
Lead incident management governance, operational reviews, risk management, and remediation programs.
Establish metrics-driven management practices centered on business outcomes, engineering productivity, and customer satisfaction.

Organizational Leadership

Lead and develop managers and senior engineering leaders.
Build a high-performing culture centered on accountability, innovation, inclusion, and technical excellence.
Drive talent acquisition, retention, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness.
Foster collaboration across geographically distributed teams spanning the US and India.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications

12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD
12+ years of software engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or data platform experience.
5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and engineering teams.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Proven experience leading large-scale platform, infrastructure, cloud, or enterprise data engineering organizations.
Strong background in distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, platform services, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated success driving organizational transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
Experience leading hybrid-cloud platform strategies and enterprise-scale modernization programs.
Deep understanding of data platforms, AI infrastructure, analytics platforms, governance, and platform engineering disciplines.
Experience building customer-centric platform organizations with strong service-oriented operating models.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, distributed compute, storage systems, data infrastructure, observability, and reliability engineering.
Demonstrated executive presence and ability to influence VP and SVP-level stakeholders.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business preferred.
Leadership Expectations
Strategic Enterprise Thinking
Organizational Leadership & Change Management
Technology Vision and Innovation
Customer-Centric Mindset
Executive Communication
Data-Driven Decision Making
Talent Development and Coaching
Cross-Functional Influence and Collaboration

Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $219,100.00 to $ 350,800.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

added.title: Director, Data Engineering
added.description:
💈 
WHO WE ARE

SQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities. We believe the pursuit of artistry and autonomy should not be restricted by the complexities of running a business. With SQUIRE, we provide custom-branded tools, resources, and guidance to help barbers of all stages and experience levels attract and retain more customers, efficiently manage their shop operations, and increase their revenue.

Founded in 2015, SQUIRE is trusted by more than 30,000 barbers across 5,000+ shops in more than a thousand cities worldwide. From streamlined booking and opening new shops to real-time earning dashboards and building lasting customer relationships, SQUIRE supports shop owners in seamlessly bridging the gap between their personal craft and business goals. SQUIRE enables barbers everywhere to unlock their full potential both as artists and as entrepreneurs.

For more information, please visit getsquire.com or download the SQUIRE app from the App or Play Store.

🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

At SQUIRE, trusted data turns information into action - powering everything from company-wide reporting and automation to the AI capabilities shaping our next chapter. We're hiring a Director, Data Engineering
to build and lead our Data organization through a player-coach model, spending approximately half your time hands-on in the code and the other half developing engineers, setting technical direction, and owning the organization’s strategy. You’ll own SQUIRE’s long-term data architecture and lead a growing team spanning Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, and Analytics.

Success in this role means building a data foundation the company trusts by default, with reliable pipelines, clear standards, and scalable systems. You'll have the authority and accountability to make architectural and organizational decisions needed to move the function forward while helping the team grow in both capability and impact. As SQUIRE continues to scale, your work will directly enable more confident decision-making, stronger automation, and AI use cases that power our next phase of growth.

Reports To
: Chief Product and Technology Officer
Location
: Remote - US or Canada
Type
: Full-Time
Compensation
: Base ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)

🧰 YOUR CRAFT (Job Duties & Responsibilities)

Design, build, and debug the highest-impact pipelines, connecting our business systems, including CRM, billing, and internal platforms to our Snowflake warehouse, in both directions

Own the data strategy and architecture across a multi-year horizon, while maintaining deep, hands-on familiarity with the systems and their edge cases

Establish technical direction and standards for pipeline design, data modeling, and data quality across the org; personally build and ship the highest-risk or most ambiguous work

Build, structure, and lead a growing Data organization of 5+ across Data Engineering, ML Engineering, and Analytics

Own headcount planning, hiring strategy, and budget for the Data organization

Partner with the Chief Product and Technology Officer and cross-functional leaders to translate company strategy into data contracts and platform investments

Lead audits of existing integrations and automations, and determine what should be replaced and how that work should be prioritized

Champion AI and automation enablement company-wide, ensuring agents and LLM use cases are built on a trusted data foundation, while remaining hands-on in building select enablement capabilities

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not a comprehensive list, and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time based on business needs.

⚙️ YOUR FOUNDATION (Experience & Skills)

8+ years in data or software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers

Experience building and leading a multidisciplinary data organization (data, ML, analytics, software) of 5+ people

Advanced SQL and Python skills, along with strong MDM fundamentals, with the technical depth to lead by example

Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent), dbt, and an orchestration tool such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, beyond just an architectural understanding

Direct experience setting AI and LLM enablement strategy and building with LLM tooling

Comfortable operating at Director scope ( owning budgets, advocating for roadmaps, and translating technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders ) while remaining directly involved in technical execution

✂️ EXTRA CUT (Nice to Haves)

Experience building AI agents with LLMs ( wired models into real systems with tool use, retrieval, and orchestration ) and with the ability to guide others doing similar work

Backend engineering experience (ideally in JS/TS) with sufficient depth to effectively evaluate architecture

Strong ML and MLOps knowledge, with the ability to set direction, assess technical tradeoffs, and support ML Engineering Leads

Experience with Salesforce, Stripe, Gong, or reverse ETL (Polytomic), and data governance / PII handling at a company-wide policy level

Don’t let this list stop you from applying - If you are interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you!

🚀 WHY SQUIRE?
As a Director, Data Engineering, you’ll have real ownership over a function the whole company depends on, a mandate to develop its leadership structure, and the charter to define the data foundation for SQUIRE's AI future — with the authority to turn that strategy into a lasting practice.

🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

Base Salary ($200,000 - $230,000) +  Bonus (15%)

New hire stock grant

100% employer-paid medical/dental/vision insurance for you and your dependents

401K plan with company contribution

Generous PTO and Parental Leave policies

Interview Accommodations

SQUIRE is committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to recruiting@getsquire.com and someone on our team will respond to your request.

Equal Employment Opportunity

This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

added.title: VP of Engineering and AI Architecture
added.description:
Job Title:
VP, Engineering & AI Architecture

Location:
Remote (Atlanta / East Coast / Central Time Zone preferred)

About The Company

Our client is a national education and behavioral health organization dedicated to helping children achieve better academic, behavioral, and emotional outcomes through evidence-based programs delivered in partnership with schools, families, and communities. The company operates a continuum of services spanning specialized education, intervention programs, behavioral health, professional learning for educators, and autism therapy through their divisions. This client is transitioning from a people-centric model into one that leverages AI-enabled capabilities to create operational efficiency and enterprise value. They are committed to mission-driven innovation, forward-deployed execution, and building a lean, high-performance engineering organization that makes a measurable difference in the lives of children, families, and educators.

Job Summary

We are looking for a VP, Engineering & AI Architecture to join the client's transformation leadership team in a remote capacity. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect-builder with deep technical credibility, strong AI engineering experience, and the executive presence to partner with senior leaders across the organization. This role will lead the design and execution of the client's interoperable engineering and AI architecture — transforming a largely outsourced and distributed engineering model into a product-minded, AI-enabled, forward-deployed engineering organization.

Key Responsibilities

Interoperable Infrastructure: Design shared services, APIs, integration patterns, platform capabilities, and reusable engineering components across the enterprise, enabling consistent and scalable architecture across all divisions.
AI Architecture: Shape the architecture for Enterprise Claude, agentic workflows, AI governance, prompt and context strategies, retrieval patterns, and business-aligned automation — connecting AI capabilities directly to measurable operational outcomes.
Vendor Transition & Engineering Standards: Manage and transition the current outsourced China third-party engineering environment within an 18-month horizon while establishing firm standards for software design, DevSecOps, CI/CD, code quality, observability, security, and architecture review.
Forward-Deployed Engineering: Build a model where engineering partners directly with operating divisions to solve high-value workflow, automation, and product problems — shifting from centralized project delivery to a forward-deployed execution model.
Team Building & Executive Partnership: Hire and lead a high-performing team of approximately six to seven engineering and AI resources; partner with the CEO, CIO, VP Enterprise Data, and operating leaders to align architecture and roadmap with business priorities and PE value creation goals.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, platform engineering, AI engineering, cloud systems, or technical product leadership; demonstrated experience managing outsourced or offshore engineering vendors and transitioning knowledge to internal teams.
Technical Skills: Hands-on familiarity with AWS-hosted operational systems, Azure SQL Server data pipelines, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI; experience designing AI-enabled platforms, LLM applications, enterprise copilots, agentic workflows, prompt/context management, retrieval patterns, and AI governance; strong working knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, testing, code quality, security, and access control.
Certifications: No specific certifications required; relevant cloud or architecture certifications (AWS, Azure) are a plus.
Other: Ability to evaluate architecture, code quality, platform design, engineering velocity, vendor performance, and technical debt independently without a large supporting organization; comfort operating at speed in a lean, PE-backed environment where quality, innovation, and measurable value creation all matter.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven experience building AI and agentic capabilities in production enterprise environments, including Enterprise Claude or similar LLM platforms.
Background in multi-site services, education, healthcare, or PE-backed organizations.
Track record of standing up an engineering function, standards, and team from an early-stage maturity base.
Strong product mindset — thinks beyond tickets and projects; focused on users, adoption, workflow outcomes, and operational change.
Experience with token and value optimization for AI workloads, including cost-aware AI architecture and ROI measurement.
OKR-based management experience in lean, high-accountability organizations.

Benefits

Competitive Salary: Competitive salary and bonus structure.
Health and Wellness: Comprehensive benefits package available — details provided during the interview process.
Work-Life Balance: Remote-first role with flexibility; East Coast / Central Time Zone preferred.
Professional Development: High-visibility transformation role with direct partnership with CEO, CIO, and PE ownership — significant opportunity for career growth and enterprise impact.
Additional Perks: Mission-driven organization improving outcomes for children, families, educators, and communities at scale; opportunity to build a function, team, and architecture from the ground up.

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Vice President Software Engineer within Controllers Engineering, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high performing team of 10+ engineers. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA & Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.

It is being modernized into AI-powered fully cloud-native reconciliation platform will autonomously match, validate, assign and explain exceptions across all businesses—delivering real-time accuracy, auditability, and insight at scale.

added.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering – Marketplace
added.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role

As a leader in Marketplace Software, you will lead the team responsible for Marketplace Management Tools: the software Zipline teams use to run, understand, and continuously improve the marketplace. You will turn complex operational workflows into simple, durable products that make it easier to manage day-to-day marketplace health, resolve issues quickly, and scale an exceptional delivery experience. This is a hands-on product-engineering leadership role, partnering closely with Product and Operations to make the right bets and deliver meaningful marketplace impact. This role does not own the core platform or partner integrations.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and grow an exceptional team of software engineers.
Own the roadmap and execution for a group of marketplace management tools, services, and products.
Build a beloved marketplace app.
Partner closely with Product to bring clarity to the chaos and enable top engineers to move at high velocity.
Work with technical leads to improve the software architecture to enable efficient scaling.

What You'll Bring

A track record of leading software engineering teams that ship operationally complex, customer-facing software.
Strong technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and execution so a lean team can get a lot done.
A track record of hiring, coaching, and developing exceptional engineers.
Excellent product sense, prioritization, and cross-functional partnership.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating clarity where others see chaos.

What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $217,000 - $270,000 depending on experience. This is a target starting range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications; the final cash offer will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role also includes equity compensation and benefits (medical, dental, vision, PTO, and more).

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Woodward is committed to creating a great workplace for all team members. Our company and its members are committed to acting with integrity, being respectful and accountable to one another, and staying humble and driven, while

maintaining the highest professional and ethical standards.

We are steadfastly committed to attracting the best talent across our communities creating a rewarding workplace. Together we are fulfilling our purpose to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future.

Woodward supports our members’ wellbeing and regularly benchmarks with other companies in our industry to offer an extensive Total Reward package for this position.
Salary will be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

The Senior Strategic Product Technology & Capture Manager
will Lead strategic business development initiatives that drive growth in existing and emerging markets by combining deep technical expertise, market intelligence, product strategy, and capture leadership. Develop and execute market strategies, identify new business opportunities, shape technology investments, and lead pursuit activities from opportunity identification through proposal submission. Collaborate across engineering, product management, marketing, and executive leadership to position innovative solutions, strengthen customer relationships, and secure profitable growth in aerospace and adjacent markets. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of aerospace systems
and a proven ability to lead technology-driven product development
efforts in this highly specialized field. A robust technical foundation and hands-on experience in aerospace applications
are essential for success in this role.

LEVEL II

Estimated annual base pay: $114,000 (minimum) - $148,000 (midpoint) - $182,000 (maximum)

LEVEL III

Estimated annual base pay: $132,000(minimum) - $171,000(midpoint) - $211,000(maximum)

All levels are eligible for the following benefits:

All members included in annual cash bonus opportunity.
401(k) match (4.5%)
Annual Woodward stock contribution (5%)
Tuition reimbursement and Training/Professional Development opportunities for all members
12 paid holidays
Industry leading medical, dental, and vision Insurance upon date of hire
Vacation / Sick Time / Vacation Buy-up / Short Term Disability / Bereavement leave.
Paid parental leave.
Adoption Assistance
Employee Assistance Program, including mental health benefits.
Member Life & AD&D / Long Term Disability / Member Optional Life
Member referral bonus
Spouse / Child Optional Life / Optional AD&D / Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending
Voluntary benefits, including:
Home / Auto Insurance discounts
Whole Life Insurance / Critical Illness Insurance / Legal Assistance / Military Leave

LEVEL II -Successful candidates typically have:

Strong Aerospace Experience
Engineering degree
5+ years experience
Flight Control Actuation Background
Hydraulic systems experience

LEVEL III - Successful candidates typically have:

Strong Aerospace Experience
Engineering degree
10+ years experience
Flight Control Actuation Background
Hydraulic systems experience
Proposal management and business capture experience is preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and execute comprehensive business development, market growth, and product technology strategies aligned with organizational objectives.
Assess market opportunities, customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities and support strategic decision-making.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships through demonstrated technical expertise, market insight, and trusted partnership.
Lead capture planning and pursuit efforts, including opportunity qualification, customer assessments, win strategies, competitive analysis, pricing strategies, and proposal development.
Develop system-level solutions and proposals for new programs, leveraging existing technologies and identifying opportunities for innovative technology development.
Craft compelling value propositions, messaging, and positioning strategies that clearly communicate differentiated customer value.
Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams to execute strategic pursuits, product launches, technology initiatives, and business growth programs.
Develop and communicate market intelligence, customer insights, competitive assessments, and strategic recommendations to leadership and pursuit teams.
Establish and cultivate industry partnerships, strategic alliances, and key stakeholder relationships to strengthen competitive positioning in aerospace and adjacent markets.
Collaborate with engineering and Chief Technology leadership to identify, evaluate, and prioritize research and development investments that align with future market opportunities.
Oversee proposal development activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and timely delivery of winning proposals.
Lead technical presentations, customer engagements, and executive reviews to communicate business strategies, solutions, and value propositions.
Identify and guide exploratory studies and strategic initiatives that may evolve into future business or technology opportunities.
Utilize data analytics and customer feedback to refine strategies, improve market positioning, and optimize business development effectiveness.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic Business Development – Identifying, qualifying, and capturing new business opportunities aligned with long-term growth objectives.
Strategic Thinking & Market Vision – Translating market trends, customer needs, and technology developments into actionable growth strategies.
Capture & Pursuit Management – Leading opportunity shaping, competitive positioning, and proposal development efforts.
Market & Competitive Intelligence – Evaluating market dynamics, customer priorities, and competitor activities to inform business decisions.
Customer Relationship Management – Building credibility and influence with customers through technical expertise and business acumen.
Technology Strategy & Innovation – Aligning technology investments and product roadmaps with future market requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership – Influencing and coordinating diverse teams across engineering, marketing, sales, operations, and executive leadership.
Executive Communication – Presenting complex technical and business concepts clearly to customers, leadership, and stakeholders.
Partnership Development – Establishing strategic alliances and industry relationships that enhance business competitiveness.
Proposal & Program Leadership – Driving high-quality, compliant proposals and coordinating complex business pursuits.
Analytical Decision Making – Leveraging market data, customer insights, and business metrics to guide investment and growth decisions.
Project & Portfolio Management – Managing multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining alignment with strategic priorities.

added.title: Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking an executive to serve as Chief Technology Officer
, driving execution across product and engineering while placing artificial intelligence at the center of the organization's architecture and systems. In this role, the executive will own the entire technical architecture, building it AI-first and utilizing modern practices for agentic engineering.

This is a builder and architect role requiring direct engagement in system design, reviews, and code. The Chief Technology Officer will conceive and execute engineering strategy, guide technical infrastructure to support modular business operations, lead organizational resourcing and workforce planning, and spearhead the deployment of production-grade agentic workflows.

Responsibilities

• Formulate and own the organization's overarching technology and AI strategy, establishing clear architectural standards and driving alignment with executive leadership.
• Own the complete AI architecture, including foundation model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, guardrails, evaluation, and inference cost control.
• Deploy agentic engineering at scale across core business workflows such as matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations, taking direct ownership of operational outcomes.
• Establish measurable AI quality benchmarks, owning evaluation frameworks, regression suites, and review loops to validate system performance.
• Direct end-to-end platform architecture across services, data pipelines, system boundaries, and interfaces to maintain reliability, high throughput, and secure-by-design standards.
• Manage operational performance across AI-dependent pathways, addressing latency, model drift, and provider outages while balancing build-versus-buy trade-offs and technical debt.
• Modernize engineering practices through AI-assisted development, code review, testing, and operational workflows to increase developer velocity.
• Lead workforce planning and engineering resourcing, including roadmap scoping, team sizing, headcount allocation, role specification, and the hiring of top-tier talent.
• Define and uphold engineering quality standards, mentoring teams on agentic practices and conducting rigorous technical and architectural reviews.
• Guide the organization through defined milestones, moving from initial architectural and organizational assessments to deploying production agentic workflows and establishing an industry-leading engineering organization.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including substantial experience as a Chief Technology Officer, Vice President of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
• Deep, hands-on technical command of modern AI engineering, including foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation frameworks, with demonstrated experience building and fine-tuning models from the ground up.
• Proven track record of deploying agentic systems at scale against production business processes with measurable outcomes in cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue.
• Rigorous approach to AI evaluation and evidence-based performance validation for models, prompts, and agentic workflows.
• Strong command of AI operational economics, including model routing, hosted versus self-hosted configurations, inference capacity, latency budgets, token spend, and provider portability.
• Demonstrated ability to write and review code, evaluate architectural design documents, analyze evaluation harnesses, and manage distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data-intensive applications at scale.
• Experience modernizing and refactoring large, load-bearing existing codebases in flight without interrupting business operations.
• Experience leading a globally distributed, remote engineering team within a technology or hyper-growth organization.
• Proven ownership of workforce planning, technical recruiting, and performance management.
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English for all documentation and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

• An advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Leadership experience within a high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform.

Essential Job Functions

• Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
• Work independently with minimal supervision.
• Utilize all required digital collaboration and productivity tools.
• Prioritize and self-manage complex workflows, operational demands, and project deadlines.

Employment Details

• Position Title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
• Location: United States (Remote)
• Employment Type: Full time
• FLSA Classification: Exempt

added.title: Senior Director, Product and Platform Security
added.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast's platform runs restaurants: the cloud software, the payments, and the hardware on the counter. Keeping it safe is an engineering problem, and we treat it that way. Instead of reviewing what our teams build after the fact, we embed security engineers alongside developers and build paved roads to deliver secure defaults that teams pick up without asking permission.

You'll lead that work as a flagship hire in Toast's new Trust & Security organization — a deliberate shift from a compliance-led, reactive security function toward one that's engineering-led and proactive. Reporting directly to the CISO, you'll be accountable for the security of the product end to end, owning the R&D relationship directly. You'll inherit an existing team of security engineers already doing this work, with plans to grow the team further as scope expands.

This is not a compliance or audit-oriented role, and not a pure individual-contributor architect seat. You'll be leading and growing a team that already has engineering's attention — not selling security to a skeptical organization from scratch. If your instinct is to review and approve rather than to build and embed, this isn't the right seat.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

Enable the Business to Lead with Security: Work closely with our product and engineering leaders to transform how security is built into our product portfolio, leveraging AI, automation, and innovation to enable both fast and secure capabilities to be delivered to our customers
Lead Security Platform Engineering: Own the shared services, guardrails, and secure defaults that make the safe path the easy path for every product team; consolidate overlapping tooling into a coherent, self-service set of guardrails
Drive Application & Cloud Security: Run our AppSec and CloudSec programs, secure development lifecycle, threat modeling, and software supply chain integrity; maintain a single owned view of product and cloud security posture with vulnerability SLAs met
Build Developer Enablement: Grow embedding, tooling adoption, training, and a security champions network that extends the team's reach; enable paved roads with our highest-leverage R&D teams so engineering leaders describe security as a partner rather than a blocker
Run Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management: Lead red team and penetration testing in a purple-team rhythm with detection engineering, and decide what gets fixed first; establish a working purple-team cadence with the detection function
Own Hardware Security: Extend platform security practices into hardware as part of the broader product security remit
Lead and Grow the Team: Lead the existing security engineering team, developing them and shaping how the function operates; identify and hire additional senior security engineers as scope and priorities expand

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

You've run a multi-team security engineering organization, rather than a single-team application security queue.
Depth in cloud-native security: infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipeline security, containers, and microservices.
You've shifted security left through self-service and paved roads, and you can show that developer friction went down while coverage went up.
Senior engineering leaders have treated you as a peer. You've changed how a product organization builds, not just flagged what it built wrong.
Judgment about where to automate, where to embed, and where to hold a line.
A background in engineering or software development rather than traditional audit or consulting, ideally from a modern SaaS or cloud-native company rather than a heavily regulated, policy-driven environment.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

A view on securing AI in a product.
Experience and judgment negotiating compromise with engineering teams in difficult situations, without losing ground on the things that matter.
Fintech background — helpful, though more relevant to other roles on the Trust & Security team than this one.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$275,000—$440,000 USD

Zone B

$238,000—$381,000 USD

Zone C

$215,000—$344,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

added.description:
Role Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Core Engineering is seeking an experienced AI Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and adoption of AI-powered capabilities across enterprise platforms and business workflows. Reporting to the Head of Product for Core Engineering, this role will be responsible for identifying opportunities to apply AI, automation, and intelligent workflow technologies across Human Resources, Finance, Expense Management, Procurement, and other enterprise functions.

This individual will serve as a subject matter expert in leveraging AI to transform how work gets done across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep business process expertise with strong product management capabilities and practical knowledge of modern AI technologies. They must be able to connect the dots across business domains, identify common patterns and opportunities, and drive horizontal solutions that can be scaled across multiple functions rather than creating isolated point solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and investment strategy for AI-powered enterprise workflow solutions.
Identify and prioritize opportunities to leverage generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration technologies to improve operational effectiveness.
Partner closely with stakeholders across HR, Finance, Expense Management, Procurement, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to understand business challenges and identify high-impact use cases.
Develop a deep understanding of enterprise workflows and operating models to uncover opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, and AI enablement.
Drive the creation of scalable, cross-functional solutions that can be leveraged across multiple business areas rather than point solutions designed for individual teams.
Translate business requirements into clear product capabilities, technical requirements, and measurable outcomes.
Lead all phases of the product lifecycle, including discovery, business case development, solution design, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and post-launch optimization.
Establish success metrics, monitor adoption and business impact, and continuously refine products based on user feedback and performance data.
Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture, Security, and Platform teams to deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, bringing innovative ideas and practical applications into the organization.
Develop executive communications, investment proposals, roadmap presentations, and product updates for senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in product management, digital transformation, enterprise technology, or related leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, workflow, or enterprise platform solutions at scale.
Strong domain expertise in one or more of the following areas:
Human Resources
Finance
Expense Management
Proven experience redesigning business processes and operating models through technology, automation, and AI.
Ability to identify common business challenges across functions and create scalable, enterprise-wide solutions.
Experience gathering requirements from senior business stakeholders and translating them into actionable product roadmaps.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and executive influence skills.
Experience working in agile product development environments and leading cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and drive execution across complex organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Oracle and/or SAP platforms, including workflow automation, process optimization, enterprise integrations, and platform modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise systems supporting HR, Finance, Procurement, Expense Management, or related business functions.
Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, governance, security, compliance, and regulatory considerations.
Familiarity with large language models, generative AI platforms, AI agents, RAG architectures, workflow orchestration frameworks, and intelligent automation technologies.
Experience developing business cases, operating models, and ROI frameworks for AI investments.
Experience leading enterprise platform strategies that span multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
MBA or equivalent business and technology leadership experience.

Success Profile

The successful candidate will be recognized as a trusted advisor and thought leader in applying AI to enterprise workflows. They will possess a unique combination of business process expertise, product leadership, systems thinking, and practical AI knowledge. Most importantly, they will demonstrate the ability to connect business needs across functions, identify common opportunities, and build scalable horizontal capabilities that drive measurable efficiency, productivity, and business value across The Core Engineering organization and the broader firm.

added.title: Chief Technology Officer
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual salary: $220,000 to $230,000,
commensurate with experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
403(b) retirement plan with an employer match.
Paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Paid parental leave.
Professional development and education reimbursement assistance.
Monthly technology and wellness stipend.

Additional Information

Essential duties reflect the primary functions assigned to this role and may be adjusted or reassigned at any time.
Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions, absent undue hardship.
The organization maintains a zero-tolerance policy regarding abuse and inappropriate behavior.

Director, Software Engineering

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead Hardware System Integration, Handler, Test Engineering, and Portfolio Engineering for semiconductor test platforms supporting SLT, Burn-In, HPC, and ATE. 
The role leads global teams responsible for equipment-control software, material handling integration, test engineering, factory interfaces, production data, and shared software capabilities. 
This position is expected to be highly technical and hands-on with software and hardware, with approximately 50% of time spent directly coding, debugging, and solving complex technical issues across the semiconductor test ecosystem. 
Key Responsibilities

Translate engineering strategy into engineering plans, technical milestones, resource plans, and delivery schedules. 
Lead software managers, technical leads, developers, and test engineers across Thermal, System Integration, Handler, Test, and Portfolio Engineering. 
Drive execution across multiple products and customer programs and ensure teams deliver committed milestones. 
Align software development, integration, validation, and release schedules with SW Product Management and Hardware TPMs. 
Lead software integration across testers, handlers, thermal systems, device interfaces, PLCs, firmware, and equipment-control systems. 
Lead development of communication interfaces for material handling, factory automation, and factory management systems. 
Lead GEM/SECS, EAC/EAP, lot processing, alarms, availability reporting, equipment telemetry, and production data capabilities. 
Lead automated validation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, regression, endurance testing, system qualification, and production readiness. 
Improve throughput, reliability, availability, recovery, and downtime through system performance analysis. 
Drive reuse and standardization of APIs, SDKs, messaging, data models, logging, diagnostics, and common software components. 
Ensure customer requirements are implemented as scalable, configurable product capabilities. 
Track milestones, dependencies, risks, quality, integration readiness, and release criteria across the portfolio. 
Improve software development, testing, validation, and release processes. 
Coordinate execution with Product Management, Program Management, Business Development, Hardware, Firmware, QA, Production, Applications, and Product Support. 
Lead adoption of AI-assisted software development, testing, diagnostics, and documentation. 
Conduct architecture, design, integration, and release-readiness reviews. 
Present technical and program-readiness reviews to customers and internal leadership. 
Support customer technical discussions, system bring-up, escalations, and production deployments. 
Conduct performance reviews, set goals, mentor leaders, and support succession planning. 
All other duties as assigned.

Requirements Required Skills & Experience

B.S in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering with a strong software background, Software Engineering, or related field; M.S. preferred. 
15+ years of software engineering or related technical experience. 
10+ years of technical engineering management experience.

Strong knowledge of GEM/SECS and related SEMI standards. 
Strong understanding of semiconductor test and measurement principles. 
Experience integrating software with testers, handlers, thermal systems, PLCs, firmware, drivers, and production equipment. 
Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, messaging, telemetry, databases, and equipment-control software.

Experience managing multiple products and customer programs, including schedules, resources, dependencies, and technical risks. 
Strong understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, release management, observability, and production support.

Strong customer, technical, executive, and cross-functional communication skills.

Experience with handler, thermal, PLC, and tester integration.

Experience modernizing legacy systems while maintaining compatibility with installed environments. 
Experience applying AI to software development, testing, diagnostics, or documentation. 
Experience leading engineering teams across the U.S. and international locations.

On-site presence in the Lake Forest, CA office is required.
